evaluation: 24 capability profiles x 20 episodes x 20 rounds per trained seed; 5 trained seeds per condition
caveats: Layouts are familiar within each experiment; no layout holdout.
All versions use the same frozen 1096 layouts and counterbalanced schedule.
v2 changes allocation masks, switch cooldowns, no-influence assignment and PPO recurrent replay resets.
v3 changes only influence-enabled initialization relative to v2; no-influence retains v2 random assignment.
Standard deviations describe 5 trained seeds, not confidence intervals or a causal comparison.
Successful completion time excludes failures; return includes their penalties.
Episode steps count environment transitions across all 20 rounds, including initialization and timeouts, through the first final done.
